thesis: Upwork (Nasdaq: UPWK), Q3 2026 10-Q (0001627475-26-000055, filed 2026-11-02; MD&A read to the key metrics table, remainder truncated). Q3 revenue 185.6M vs 201.7M (-8.0%), 9M 572.7M vs 589.4M (-2.8%). GSV Q3 914.1M -10% (9M 2.87B -5%); Marketplace take rate 20.0% vs 18.9% (+110 bps) from ads, Business Plus and variable pricing; Adjusted EBITDA 63.8M +7% (9M 185.3M vs 172.7M); GAAP NI Q3 31.8M, 9M 88.7M vs 99.8M. TTM (FY2025 + 9M26 - 9M25): NI 104.3M, OCF 199.5M, capex 8.0M, capitalized software 31.6M, FCF 159.9M, SBC 56.1M (FCF after SBC 103.8M). Close 9.93 on 2026-11-13 (stockanalysis, Yahoo agree), 125,777,139 shares (cover 2026-10-29): market cap 1,249M, 12.0x TTM GAAP NI, FCF yield 12.8% (8.3% after SBC). Balance sheet 2026-09-30: cash 228.0M, marketable securities 76.3M, no debt (360.998M converts repaid 2026-08-15 from cash; 150M revolver undrawn), total liabilities 277.1M, equity 654.0M; excludes 164.6M escrow funds. WorkMotion (German employer-of-record) bought 2026-10-30 for about 129.7M cash, so cash plus securities falls to about 175M pro forma. 8.3M shares bought back for 109.7M in 9M26 (none in Q3; 254.3M authorization left). 2026 restructuring cut workforce about 20% (18.1M charges 9M). The market probably prices a shrinking marketplace hurt by AI and SEO changes; evidence that differs is rising take rate, EBITDA growth and net cash, but the revenue base is still falling and management says GSV, clients and revenue pressures continue through 2026.
counterthesis: GSV fell 10% in Q3 and the decline accelerated from -5% in 9M; revenue is held up only by take rate, which has limits and may be pushed through on a shrinking client base. Management cites difficulty acquiring and keeping clients, AI substituting for some freelance work, SEO changes and macro. Cheap multiples can be a value trap if earnings follow GSV down. GAAP NI is lowered by higher amortization of capitalized software and restructuring; FCF is flattered by SBC (56M TTM) and capitalized software excluded by many aggregators. 9M OCF fell to 135.8M from 184.6M. Cash was used for a 129.7M acquisition on top of buybacks of 109.7M, so the cushion is thinner; acquisition accounting, goodwill and integration are unread. Peers (FVRR, FIVR-like, marketplaces), own history, full MD&A client counts, guidance and 10-K risk factors not read.
invalidation: Thesis fails if quarterly GSV declines worsen beyond about -10% with take rate gains exhausted, Adjusted EBITDA turns down, OCF stays below roughly 150M annualized, or acquisitions and buybacks consume net cash without stabilizing the client count.
